title: Listening Drill — Boat shed route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Boat shed route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the rowing session. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the riverside gate. From there, walk towards the ticket booth. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the rowing club.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the launch ramp today. The surface is wet and slippery. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
